step1_figure.circuit_type: Cascode OTA with Common-Source Output Buffer (Two-Stage Op-Amp)
step1_figure.description: Figure 24.37 shows a cascode OTA first stage driving a PMOS common-source output stage (M7) with cascoded NMOS current sink load (M8T, M8B) and indirect compensation via capacitor Cc connected to the low-impedance cascode node. Figure 24.39 shows the closed-loop test setup with R1 = R2 = 10k driving a 1 pF capacitive load.

open_loop_gain.description: Low-frequency DC open-loop voltage gain of the two-stage op-amp

equation.explanation: Product of the cascode OTA first-stage gain and the common-source second-stage gain
equation.assumptions: First stage unloaded by high-impedance gate of M7; second stage loaded by its cascoded current source and 1 pF load

sky130_expected.calculation: First stage gain A1 ≈ 500 (~54 dB) as given on page 799. Second stage CS gain A2 = gm7 * (ro7 || R_ocas8). For I_D7 = 100 uA, gm7 = sqrt(2 * up*Cox * (W/L) * ID) = sqrt(2 * 50u * 500 * 100u) = 2.24 mA/V. ro7 = 1/(lambda * ID) = 1/(0.1 * 100u) = 100 kohm. A2 ≈ gm7 * ro7 ≈ 2.24m * 100k ≈ 224 (47 dB). With practical cascode loading and channel-length modulation, A_OLDC ≈ 65 dB to 75 dB (approx. 70 dB in Fig. 24.38).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Fig. 24.38 shows a low-frequency open-loop gain of roughly 70 dB.

unity_gain_frequency.description: Frequency where the open-loop gain drops to 0 dB (unity gain)

equation.explanation: Effective unity-gain bandwidth determined by the transconductance of the input pair and the indirect compensation capacitance Cc
equation.assumptions: Cc = 240 fF sets the dominant pole through pole splitting

sky130_expected.calculation: For input pair biased at 10 uA per branch: gm = sqrt(2 * 270u * 25 * 10u) ≈ 367 uA/V (or typical 150-300 uA/V). With Cc = 240 fF: fun = 150u / (2 * pi * 240 fF) ≈ 99.5 MHz, or with gm=200 uA/V, fun ≈ 130 MHz. Fig. 24.38 indicates fun ≈ 60 MHz - 100 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Matches Fig. 24.38 open-loop response crossing 0 dB around 70-100 MHz.

phase_margin.description: Phase margin of the open-loop response driving a 1 pF load

equation.explanation: Phase of the open-loop transfer function evaluated at the unity-gain frequency
equation.assumptions: Driving CL = 1 pF and compensated with Cc = 240 fF

sky130_expected.calculation: Page 800 explicitly states: 'The open-loop simulations driving a 1-pF load are seen in Fig. 24.38. The PM is 45° (too low if the op-amp will be used in a unity follower configuration).'
sky130_expected.reasoning: Explicitly specified as 45 degrees in the textbook text.

slew_rate_falling.description: Negative-going slew rate when discharging the 1 pF load capacitor

equation.explanation: Current sink M8 (M8T/M8B conducting 100 uA) discharges the output load capacitance CL = 1 pF
equation.assumptions: Output stage bias current I_M8 = 100 uA, CL = 1 pF

sky130_expected.reasoning: 100 uA output current sink discharging 1 pF load.

slew_rate_rising.description: Positive-going slew rate when charging the 1 pF load capacitor

equation.explanation: PMOS pull-up device M7 turns on hard during rising step to pull up CL quickly
equation.assumptions: M7 conducts well over 100 uA transiently when input steps down

sky130_expected.calculation: M7 is a large PMOS (W/L = 1000/2). When driven ON, peak transient current exceeds 200 uA. Hence SR_rise >= 200 uA / 1 pF = 200 V/us.
sky130_expected.reasoning: As noted on page 800, 'M7 can turn on and charge a load capacitor quickly'.

quiescent_supply_current.description: Total quiescent current drawn from VDD including bias circuit and both stages

equation.explanation: Sum of bias circuit current (~140 uA), cascode OTA current (~40 uA), and output stage current (100 uA)
equation.assumptions: Quiescent operating point at Vcm = 0.9 V

sky130_expected.calculation: I_DD = 140 uA (bias) + 40 uA (OTA) + 100 uA (output stage) = 280 uA.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Page 801 Fig. 24.39 caption states: 'Current from VDD. Includes the bias circuit's (Fig. 20.47) current (140 uA)' and shows baseline near 280 uA.

equation.explanation: Total static power drawn from the 1.8 V supply rail

sky130_expected.reasoning: Derived directly from quiescent supply current at 1.8 V.

closed_loop_bandwidth.description: Closed-loop -3dB bandwidth in inverting gain-of-1 configuration (R1=R2=10k)

equation.explanation: Closed-loop bandwidth set by the feedback factor beta = R1 / (R1 + R2) = 0.5

sky130_expected.reasoning: For an inverting closed-loop amplifier with noise gain of 2, bandwidth is half of fun.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench measuring open-loop gain, unity-gain frequency, phase margin, closed-loop bandwidth, rising/falling slew rates, and DC supply current/power for the CMOS op-amp of Fig. 24.37.
